title: A lint that hits its time limit keeps each passed job, so a rerun runs only the rest
why: Owner 13:10 CST Nov 19: "how come lints aren't resumeable where they left off if they hit a time limit block"; 13:12 CST: "unironically build and land this right now" (relayed by the consultant).
source: Consultant 13:12 CST Nov 19 (relayed, his reading of merge --lane-lint not read by triage 12): it runs every job fresh in a new temp tree and keeps no per-job result; PR 3694 lost about 67 minutes. Shape: store each job's verdict on disk keyed by (head sha, base sha, job name, tool version); a rerun skips a job that passed at the same key and reruns failed, timed-out or never-run jobs. Cost: one small file per job, no watcher.
note: Taken by the consultant, who builds it now (owner's word 13:12 CST). Not a triage lane.
